The funny thing about filming these training videos is that I learned from them as much as you do. For example, in this 10 minute training session with Athena, I do a couple things incorrectly. 1. I wait too long to reward her the moment she does something correctly. 2. I change the release verbiage too much. In order to perfect this trick, I need to only say the words sit stay and attack for her release. I believe everyone should film their training videos and look back to see what they did wrong even if you don't post it. Usually it's the human who is not giving clear commands and confusing the situation. Clear goals, clear language lead to clean training. Also, don't forget that this is meant to be fun, so have patience. #DogTraining #puppy

Hoje, a K-Beauty incorporou derivados e tecnologias inspiradas no PDRN em séruns e cremes para cuidados diários da pele. Mas por que todo mundo está falando dele? 👀 Em cosméticos, o PDRN é especialmente interessante para rotinas focadas em aparência de pele mais saudável, hidratada, viçosa e com sinais de envelhecimento, além de ser encontrado em fórmulas voltadas ao suporte da barreira e à melhora da aparência da textura e elasticidade. E tem um detalhe importante: nem todo produto com PDRN é igual.
